statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-63328 (GHSA-8rc5-4fr6-64pw, GO-2026-6250): the Trivy plugin manager built paths under ~/.trivy/plugins from plugin manifest metadata without confining the plugin name to that directory, so a malicious plugin that a user is persuaded to install or run can write its manifest and binary to any path the user can write. github.com/aquasecurity/trivy before 0.72.0 is affected; the affected functions are in pkg/plugin (the plugin Manager and its Install, Run, Start and related helpers) and pkg/commands (NewPluginCommand, loadPluginCommands) (https://github.com/aquasecurity/trivy/security/advisories/GHSA-8rc5-4fr6-64pw, https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-6250). The fix, https://github.com/aquasecurity/trivy/commit/d4213d7735c74e57f06c02ccb39ebca67abc7959, which confines plugin file operations to the plugin root with os.Root, first ships in v0.72.0 (https://github.com/aquasecurity/trivy/releases/tag/v0.72.0). Checked every scout-cli-dev package published for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository by 2026-11-27: 25 builds, 1.20.4-r1 to 1.30.0-r1, each for x86_64 and aarch64. Each package holds one file, /usr/bin/docker-scout, a development build of the Docker Scout CLI, which for every version records the same Go release and module versions as the scout-cli package of that version (built without the -w linker flag and without -trimpath), a statically linked Go program built with CGO_ENABLED=0 for GOOS=linux. We read the Go build information (Go release and module versions) of that program in every published package; both architectures agree for every build. github.com/aquasecurity/trivy is v0.66.0 in 1.20.4-r1 to 1.23.1-r4, v0.71.0 in 1.23.1-r5, v0.72.0 in 1.23.1-r6 to 1.23.1-r9, v0.75.0 in 1.23.1-r10 to 1.30.0-r1. So every build before 1.23.1-r6 ships an affected trivy release (v0.66.0, then v0.71.0 in 1.23.1-r5), and 1.23.1-r6 and every later build ship v0.72.0 or later, which carry the fix. We also downloaded ten published Alpine 3.23 packages ourselves (index checksums equal), scout-cli 1.20.4-r1, 1.23.1-r4 and 1.23.1-r5 for x86_64 and aarch64, scout-cli 1.21.0-r2 and 1.23.1-r10 for x86_64, scout-cli-dev 1.20.4-r1 for x86_64 and scout-cli-dev 1.23.1-r4 for aarch64, and listed their functions with go tool nm (runtime.main present in each as the positive control): none of them contains a function of github.com/aquasecurity/trivy/pkg/plugin or github.com/aquasecurity/trivy/pkg/commands, while other trivy packages are linked (for example pkg/iac/scanners/helm/parser.New). We did not list every earlier build, so the range is kept on the trivy version each build records rather than on what each build links. The range ends at 1.23.1-r6, the first build with trivy v0.72.0.
